---
name: speckit.analyze
description: Analyze consistency and traceability between spec, plan, and tasks
---
Review and analyze consistency across all generated artifacts:
1. Verify traceability from constitution and spec down to plan and tasks.
2. Check that no requirements or acceptance criteria are omitted.
3. Identify edge-case gaps or inconsistencies before writing code.
Save output to `specs/smart-task-api/analyze.md`.
